data.topic: Root-cause and fix design for git fsmonitor daemon pile-up and hangs in this repo: why the main checkout fsmonitor daemon stopped answering IPC and stalled a pre-push hook for 30 minutes, why 11 daemons accumulate across nested worktrees, what regressed sk-git/026 worktree relocation and reaper daemon handling, and how to prevent old daemons from running on. Start from specs/sk-git/035-fsmonitor-daemon-and-worktree-relocation-regression/scratch/findings.md and answer its section 8 questions.
